44:   are not a final result.

46:   actual full kernel signatures/dependencies, and fresh Lean closure. Its
47:   reviewer is an actual model/human judgment, not an automatically populated PASS.
48: - Stop on a judged substantive mathematical gap. Ordinary expansion and local

50:   establish that a mathematical claim is false.

53:

55: before any model test or benchmark. Run model authoring, planning, proof and
56: review stages through the isolated carrier. The interactive developer's memory,
57: other personal skills, expert packages, old task outputs and hidden reference
58: proofs are never an input source for these stages.
59: 
60: The Yui arm receives only the declared Yui rules and task material. The direct
61: arm receives a minimal task/tool contract and the same mathematical inputs,
62: without Yui planning, strategy or shared-proof guidance. Log actual transmitted
63: instructions, complete allowed inputs, tool schemas/results, model identity,
64: phase, usage and health. Never execute model-generated Python or shell text.
65:

68: Count root/controller, worker, review and retry calls. Cached/reasoning tokens

70:

72: or gaps, actual execution health, time/token breakdown, and reproducible commands.
73: Do not claim a universal NL0 compiler, an unconditional proof of literature
74: inputs, completed Audit C, or acceleration from this prototype alone."}

12: `spec.json` freezes the original full theorem, the conclusion under its declared

9: 
10: To prove `X -> Y`, introduce X inside one argument, derive Y from the declared
11: inputs, then discharge X into the antecedent. Output `X -> Y`, not Y. To use Y

13: elimination. A local X and a proved X are not the same proof object.

19: is accounted for. No classical double-negation elimination under an

125:    no additional nontrivial theorem is hidden in “clearly,” an analogy,

143: packet hash, prior exposure, mathematical materials read and execution evidence.

145: not fresh replay. This standard does not authorize new agent/service dispatch;
146: keep an unperformed replay UNVERIFIED. Metadata cannot authenticate a claimed
147: identity or isolation; preserve actual execution evidence and disclose limits.

153: from memory. Return the defect to authoring and review the newly frozen version.

156: checks may continue, but a blocked descendant cannot receive a whole-proof
157: pass. Report exact premises -> conclusion and the affected closure. Repairs
158: require a new graph hash and replacement audit, never a silently stronger H.

161: completion without interrupting the user for each correction. Review the
162: revised argument before accepting it. If completion stalls, apply
163: [routine completion and substantive proof gaps](nl0-authoring.md#routine-completion-and-substantive-proof-gaps)

165: into a substantive-gap report or silently begin a new proof strategy.

170: everywhere, scalar/representation changes, and constant uniformity. Negative
171: controls must distinguish machine-detectable corruption (unknown IDs, changed
172: evidence) from semantic corruption (wrong argument with unchanged structure).
173: A failed counterexample search or a valid JSON file cannot establish correctness.
174:

178: an unlisted theorem and an unsupported witness. A real reviewer receives neutral
179: packets without labels, old reviews or expected answers; the owner's answer key
180: stays outside its input directory. Require located findings, not just verdicts.
181: Manually assigning FAIL only tests receipt handling, not model detection. If no
182: reviewer ran, report NOT_RUN. `prepare-review-cases.py --help` prepares a small
183: control set without calling a model or claiming an isolation experiment.
184: 
185: Grant `DRAFT-AUDIT-PASSED` only if A0–A5 are actually completed for the exact
186: frozen artifact, every required review is PASS, source evidence is verified,
187: and P closes without extra assumptions. Say “same-context self-audit” when
188: that is the execution mode. `nl0.py --audit` verifies the hash-bound review
189: record's completeness, not the truth of the reviewer statements. Preserve any
190: FAIL/UNVERIFIED report and identify the first gap; do not erase it after repair.
191: For access-limited sources, finish with an explicit pending-citation list and
192: an incomplete/UNVERIFIED audit outcome while reporting the other completed
193: checks. Skipping unavailable citation checks does not waive them for a future
194: whole-proof pass."}
